बॉक्स ऑफिस पर धनुष और ममूटी की स्पाई एक्शन थ्रिलर OM ने पहले दिन ही बड़ा धमाका कर दिया है! 🔥

अर्ली ट्रेंड्स के मुताबिक, Rajkumar Periasamy के डायरेक्शन में बनी इस फिल्म ने भारत में अपने पहले दिन 17.85 करोड़ रुपये का नेट कलेक्शन दर्ज किया है। 💥

इसी शानदार कमाई के साथ OM ने Suriya की फिल्म Karuppu के 15.5 करोड़ के रिकॉर्ड को पीछे छोड़ दिया है। यह 2026 की चौथी सबसे बड़ी कॉलीवुड ओपनर बन चुकी है। 🎬

ऑक्यूपेंसी की बात करें तो तमिल वर्जन में 50% और तेलुगु में 45% से ज्यादा दर्शक मिले, हालांकि हिंदी वर्जन में यह सिर्फ 13% पर सुस्त रही।

रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, 200 करोड़ के भारी-भरकम बजट में बनी यह धनुष के करियर की सबसे महंगी फिल्म है और उन्होंने इसके लिए 60 करोड़ से ज्यादा की फीस ली है। 📊

क्या आप OM देखने सिनेमाघर जाने वाले हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताइए! 🤔

ctx.title: OM Box Office Day 1 (Early Trends): Pulls Off Kollywood’s 4th Biggest Opening Of 2026 In India!
ctx.summary:
Dhanush-led OM is off to a solid start at the Indian box office, crossing the 17 crore mark in net collections on day 1. 
 The post  OM Box Office Day 1 (Early Trends): Pulls Off Kollywood’s 4th Biggest Opening Of 2026 In India!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
OM, starring Dhanush, Mammootty, Sai Pallavi, Sreeleela, Naseeruddin Shah, and Indrans, has finished its opening day with impressive figures at the Indian box office. Backed by strong pre-release buzz, the film witnessed impressive pre-sales. Besides pre-sales, it saw strong over-the-counter ticket sales, resulting in Kollywood’s fourth-biggest opening of 2026 by a decent margin. Keep reading to know what early trends for day 1 suggest!
The Kollywood spy action thriller witnessed an average occupancy of over 50% throughout the day in the original Tamil version, which is strong. Telugu version was good too, with over 45% occupancy. The Hindi version remained dull with an average occupancy of just 13%. Backed by Tamil and Telugu versions, the film has closed day 1 with 17.85 crore net, as per early trends.
With an estimated 17.85 crore, OM has scored Kollywood’s fourth-biggest opening of the year at the Indian box office. It surpassed Suriya’s Karuppu ( 15.5 crore ) to claim the fourth spot.
Take a look at Kollywood’s top openers of 2026 (net):
OM is written and directed by Rajkumar Periasamy. It is produced by Dhanush, Shraddha Agrawal, and Azmat Jagmag under the banner of Wunderbar Films and RTake Studios.
If reports are to be believed, OM is made on a budget of 200 crore . With such a big number, it has become Dhanush’s most expensive film ever. It is even heard that the actor has charged an upfront fee of 60 crore+ , accounting for a substantial portion of the massive budget. With such high costs involved, the film must perform really strongly at the Indian box office to enter the safe zone.
